title: Just ok; zero edge support!
text: Just ok; zero edge support!. This mattress is just okay. For the price I feel like it should be much better. My biggest gripe with this is that the edges are not reinforced and sturdy. The entire edge is floppy and soft and when you get in and out of bed it’s like you’re rolling downhill. This also makes sitting on the edge of the bed nearly impossible because it’s so soft. I’ve never experienced this with a bed before. I replaced my 5 year old California king with this nectar mattress and I’m pretty shocked at how disappointed I am. You can see from the pictures I have included with my review that the seam for the cover falls to the side of the mattress by about 2 inches. The entire mattress is covered with a zippered cloth cover. The top is soft memory foam. I don’t feel any could in the bottom part. I would not reorder this mattress again. I’m sleeping fine on it. It regulates my body temperature too. But the soft sides are a deal breaker for me.
